observations: RayCaster and ShapeCaster retain both local and global origin/direction, apply an entity exclusion filter when configured and clear old hits before a cast. A one-hit limit invokes the dedicated first-hit query; larger limits invoke multi-hit queries. Actual global-coordinate update systems, native spatial query implementation and application callers remain open.

Shape casts carry shape rotation, max and target distance and penetration choices through a ShapeCastConfig. Both RayHits and ShapeHits expose hit vectors and sort by partial distance comparison with unwrap; native hit-value guarantees and supported callers are required before asserting a panic or ordering defect.

The ShapeCaster documentation contains conflicting default-hit-count wording, while its Default implementation explicitly sets one. This is a native source observation, not a product behavior finding. Examples were read, not run; archive match does not resolve features, execution or independent lens completion. No product build, test, simulation or runtime probe ran.
